author: bobyv87
text:
Hey HCDE. I think there is a lot of ambiguity in this diagram and a
lot of variables too. Firstly, is this an MPL of a FL or is a QM in a
swing as a reaction to another FL/kink? If it is a QM, then price can
make a diamond up to the MPL of a FL from above. The problem with
diamonds and QM is that you can rarely find an engulf which hasn't hit
its target so you have to gamble on them a little bit, i think. So,
knowing that you can't find a engulf which hasn't hit its target
nowadays, its definitely almost impossible to take gambling out of
equation even when you trade BSZ. You have two important things to
think about when you try to score your BSZ trade: - FLAG(BSZ) not
touching the kink (so you can take FTB to that kink), and an engulf down
 (which is impossible to find it nowadays). So basically, from what i
have seen in my study in forex tester, i cant expect more than 60% P/L
ratio on these things and often the initial R is less than 1:1 because
your kink is larger than your BSZ FO zone. If you want high R you have
to be more agressive and i dont know, i think P/L ratio will drop down
even more. Maybe i do something wrong but this is how i see it now. We
have to deal with losses. I think i do something wrong, but so far this
 is how i see it. And regarding range filling, how can you expect for a
range to be filled if you have no engulf which hasn't hit its target,
you are not at the QM zone, and even if you are, price can make a
diamond to an MPL of the FL from above which is 2TB to it now, so its
risky.HCDE wrote:

author: Edge
text:
HCDE wrote:
Ifmyante wrote:

Hi If,

I often read you saying that price might want to "fill a range", but i don't understand what it means:

It was this type of confusion that held me back for years. You guys
raise some important issues. Here is the thing. It will never be
completely mechanical. There will always be subjectivity with our
analysis. Until we can program the greatest algo on earth to work in
unison with the IT black box's we have to understand that its art as
well as science. We need to try and stay consistent. For me I have a
complete strategy based on inferences I have made based on IFs
teachings. Training my eyes to see the order-flow/manipulation really
helped. Opening a chart and just seeing the clusters of different
behavior really helped me.

In regards to ranges etc. Its just a game of ping pong. Classically, IF
would teach price moves from FL to FL. This has slightly changed in
recent times with another method the ITs use for entries and targets as
well. Everything in between the above and below level in that scale is a
 potential range to be filled. I base nearly my entire price reading on
this. I use smaller scales to ride it up or down. Although I know where
 the levels are located, I only trade the best ones. But I need to know
where price is coming from and which level is in control on my higher
scale(s).

I never think in terms of QM, DM, CanCan anymore as it s only a
byproduct of the order flow and manipulation. If I know where the true
orders reside I couldnt care less if its a QM , diamond etc. It may be
different for you guys but this was another step forward for me. The
pattern itself is only a footprint. What lays beyond it is whats truly
amazing.

See below, here is another important point. If a flag completes, I have no use for it anymore . Cheers

IF, there is something that give me headaches sometimes. There is a
chart, it doesn't mater what chart is and what TF is for now. I did a
few drawings on it just to ask you a few questions about what scale we
working on. So there is it: 1 - its a big FL(LS) from the HTF, 2 - it is
 a to the pip kink from another much bigger LS to the left (lets say).
Now, even if FL 2 is a bigger LS kink, its still inside FLAG3 (so its in

engulf of 5 and lets say price didn't hit the MPL of 6 you will not say

all there are interlinked scales and all this Piece of PA its a reaction

green circle, after all these assumptions a Piece of PA, or not, or did

extremes of pieces of PA.

Please, all of you feel free to look at this and think about it. Its
important to know how far can price travel from a specific FL/KINK until
